items.title: HELOC Balances Jump Most Since 2005 as Fed Hike Looms
items.author: Alex Lange
items.content: <article>HELOC balances just posted their biggest quarterly jump since 2005 as homeowners hold on to low first-mortgage rates. With the Fed expected to raise rates Dec. 9, here is what a hike would cost HELOC borrowers and how to limit the hit.</article>

items.title: Real Estate Commission Rebates: State, Lender and Disclosure Rules
items.author: Alex Lange
items.content: <article>A buyer rebate may reduce transaction costs, but state law and lender rules control whether and how it can be paid. Learn what to check before agreeing to one.</article>

items.title: Closing Costs by State: What Buyers Pay in All 50 States
items.author: Alex Lange
items.content: <article>Selected purchase closing costs averaged $4,528 in LodeStar's 2025 data, excluding lender fees and commissions. Compare state averages, not borrower quotes.</article>

items.title: FHA and VA Mortgage Rates by State
items.author: Alex Lange
items.content: <article>FHA rates averaged 6.931% and VA rates 6.942% nationally on Nov. 13, 2026, about a third of a point below conventional. See FHA and VA averages for states with available data.</article>

items.title: Monthly Mortgage Payment by Home Price
items.author: Alex Lange
items.content: <article>At a 7.201% rate, a $400,000 home with 10% down costs about $2,444 a month in principal and interest. See payments for every price from $200,000 to $1 million.</article>

items.title: Jumbo vs. Conforming Mortgage Rates: How Big Is the Gap?
items.author: Alex Lange
items.content: <article>Jumbo 30-year rates averaged 7.287% on Nov. 12, 2026, vs. 7.107% for conforming loans: a gap of about 0.18 point. See what that costs and when a jumbo makes sense.</article>

items.title: Mortgage Rate Forecast for the Next 5 Years (2027–2031)
items.author: Alex Lange
items.content: <article>Fannie Mae's November forecast projects 7.2% for 2027 and 2028. Beyond that, rates depend on Treasury yields and the spread lenders charge. See five-year scenarios.</article>

items.title: PMI Rates by Credit Score and Down Payment
items.author: Alex Lange
items.content: <article>One mortgage insurer's published rate card puts monthly PMI at 0.19% to 1.86% of the loan a year, by credit score and down payment. See the chart and monthly costs.</article>

items.title: Is There a Federal First-Time Home Buyer Grant or Tax Credit in 2026?
items.author: Alex Lange
items.content: <article>There's no federal first-time home buyer tax credit or general federal down payment grant as of November 2026. Here are the bills in Congress, what they'd offer, and help you can get right now.</article>

items.title: DSCR Loans for Airbnb and Short-Term Rentals: How Lenders Count STR Income
items.author: Alex Lange
items.content: <article>DSCR lenders can qualify an Airbnb or VRBO purchase on projected rental income instead of your W-2. See how STR income is counted and example DSCR, credit and down payment requirements.</article>

items.title: When Will Mortgage Rates Go Down? What Forecasters Expect
items.author: Alex Lange
items.content: <article>Mortgage rates topped 7% in fall 2026. Fannie Mae's November forecast projects a 7.2% average in 2027 and 2028, and the MBA expects rates above 7% through 2027. Here's why, and what could bring them down sooner.</article>

items.title: Bank Statement Loan Rates and Requirements
items.author: Alex Lange
items.content: <article>One lender's bank statement loan rates ran 7.125% (with 3.5 points) to 9% in November 2026. Compare credit scores, down payments, expense factors and loan limits for self-employed borrowers.</article>

items.title: Housing Market Predictions 2027: Prices, Sales, Rates and Inventory
items.author: Alex Lange
items.content: <article>See 2027 forecasts from Fannie Mae, the MBA, Goldman Sachs and Zillow for home prices, existing-home sales and mortgage rates. The forecasts use different periods and measures.</article>

items.title: Why Wednesday’s PCE Report Could Move Mortgage Rates
items.author: Alex Lange
items.content: <article>October PCE inflation, the Q3 GDP update and new-home sales all land Wednesday, Nov. 25, two weeks before a Fed meeting where markets expect a rate hike. Here is what the numbers could mean for mortgage and HELOC rates, and what to do before the holiday.</article>

items.content: <article>Reverse mortgages aren't a scam, but scammers target the people who use them. Learn the red flags, your HECM protections, and where to...</article>

items.content: <article>FHA loans are easier to qualify for than many other mortgages. Learn what's required for an FHA loan and when it's a good option.</article>
